summary: The category, merge-permission wording, clipped diagram nodes, and diagram provenance are fixed. All four purpose outcomes now pass. The remaining weakness is allocation: the script gives head-commit binding no visual support, then spends roughly 7.5 seconds without narration on the gate destinations. Locking the timeline to music explains that hold; it does not justify its instructional value.

issues.problem: The supplied schedule still leaves roughly 7.5 seconds between “release tag through” and the closing narration. The author's rebuttal identifies a deliberate music-and-visuals hold, but the destination shot repeats the merge/tag relationship already introduced in the cold-open. Engineers get no additional stated takeaway during roughly one-sixth of the clip.
issues.fix: Keep the music timing, but use the interval for a labeled recap: “Enabled lanes → one report → gate on the head commit → merge or tag.” Alternatively, add a short spoken recap within the existing hold.

issues.problem: The narration says the gate records its result “for the head commit,” but the gate diagram contains no commit identifier or head-commit label. Viewers can repeat the sentence, but the visual teaches only a generic pass condition—not the commit binding that distinguishes this required outcome.
issues.fix: Add “Result for head commit” beneath the gate, with a short example SHA. Carry that same identifier into the report-to-gate view so the binding is explicit without adding another scene.

thirty_second_test.reason: The opening now identifies skills and hooks for coding agents; CHANGE.md and its protections are explicit; narration supplies enabled-lane aggregation and head-commit gating; the closer explicitly credits the walkthrough skill with the diagram.

purpose_test.outcome: What change fabric is: skills and hooks for coding agents that decide when a change may land
purpose_test.reason: 003-logo-open-end.jpg states “skills and hooks for coding agents.” The cold-open narration and gate destinations establish that these determine when a change may merge or receive a release tag.

purpose_test.outcome: That one CHANGE.md per repo holds the config and the protected branches and tags
purpose_test.reason: 007-change-md-start.jpg through 009-change-md-end.jpg state “One file per repo,” identify the root CHANGE.md, and show change_config plus protected_refs containing main and tag:v*.

purpose_test.outcome: That every enabled lane feeds one report and a gate on the head commit before a merge or release tag
purpose_test.reason: 011-gate-flow-middle.jpg shows the lanes converging into one report. The gate-flow narration explicitly states enabled-lane scope, result recording for the head commit, and the pass requirement before merge or release tagging. The commit binding is spoken rather than visualized.

purpose_test.outcome: That this clip itself is made by the walkthrough skill, diagram scene included
purpose_test.reason: The logo-close narration now says “Made by the walkthrough skill from one storyboard, diagram and voice included,” while 013-logo-close-start.jpg through 015-logo-close-end.jpg identify cf:walkthrough.
